SELECT r.id AS id, r.hazard_code AS hazardCode, r.flow_code AS flowCode, r.problem_source AS problemSource, r.check_name AS checkName, r.plant_id AS plantId, r.area_id AS areaId, r.location_id AS locationId, r.problem_level AS problemLevel, r.status AS status, r.check_time AS checkTime, r.hazard_category AS hazardCategory, r.create_time AS createTime, fm.field_name AS plantName, fm1.field_name AS areaName, sdi.item_name AS problemCategoryName, li.location_name AS locationName, hd.problem_description AS problemDescription FROM ytsafety_hazard_report r LEFT JOIN safety_field_manage fm ON r.plant_id = fm.id AND fm.delete_falg = 0 LEFT JOIN safety_field_manage fm1 ON r.area_id = fm1.id AND fm1.delete_falg = 0 LEFT JOIN safety_dict_item sdi ON r.problem_category = sdi.id LEFT JOIN ytsafety_location_info li ON r.location_id = li.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT process_id, ANY_VALUE(problem_description) AS problem_description FROM ytsafety_hazard_description GROUP BY process_id ) hd ON r.id = hd.process_id WHERE r.del_flag = 0 AND r.draft_status = 0
AND ( r.check_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{screeningCondition}, '%') OR (r.problem_source = 'COMPANY_INSPECTION' AND '公司级检查' LIKE CONCAT('%', #{screeningCondition}, '%')) OR (r.problem_source = 'DEPARTMENT_SELF_CHECK' AND '部门自查' LIKE CONCAT('%', #{screeningCondition}, '%')) OR (r.problem_source = 'EMPLOYEE_SNAPSHOT' AND '员工随手拍' LIKE CONCAT('%', #{screeningCondition}, '%')) OR (r.problem_source = 'PATROL_EXCEPTION' AND '巡查异常' LIKE CONCAT('%', #{screeningCondition}, '%')) OR (r.problem_level = 1 AND '低' LIKE CONCAT('%', #{screeningCondition}, '%')) OR (r.problem_level = 2 AND '一般' LIKE CONCAT('%', #{screeningCondition}, '%')) OR (r.problem_level = 3 AND '较大' LIKE CONCAT('%', #{screeningCondition}, '%')) OR (r.problem_level = 4 AND '重大' LIKE CONCAT('%', #{screeningCondition}, '%')) OR (r.status = 0 AND '草稿' LIKE CONCAT('%', #{screeningCondition}, '%')) OR (r.status = 1 AND '审批中' LIKE CONCAT('%', #{screeningCondition}, '%')) OR (r.status = 2 AND '整改中' LIKE CONCAT('%', #{screeningCondition}, '%')) OR (r.status = 3 AND '验证中' LIKE CONCAT('%', #{screeningCondition}, '%')) OR (r.status = 4 AND '部分完成' LIKE CONCAT('%', #{screeningCondition}, '%')) OR (r.status = 5 AND '已完成' LIKE CONCAT('%', #{screeningCondition}, '%')) OR (r.status = 6 AND '预期未完成' LIKE CONCAT('%', #{screeningCondition}, '%')) OR (r.status = 7 AND '逾期完成' LIKE CONCAT('%', #{screeningCondition}, '%')) OR (r.status = 8 AND '延期审批中' LIKE CONCAT('%', #{screeningCondition}, '%')) OR (r.status = 30 AND '废弃' LIKE CONCAT('%', #{screeningCondition}, '%')) OR fm.field_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{screeningCondition}, '%') OR li.location_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{screeningCondition}, '%') OR hd.problem_description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{screeningCondition}, '%') )
AND r.plant_id IN
#{factoryId}
ORDER BY r.create_time DESC

SELECT r.id AS id, r.hazard_code AS hazardCode, r.flow_code AS flowCode, r.problem_source AS problemSource, r.check_name AS checkName, r.plant_id AS plantId, r.area_id AS areaId, r.location_id AS locationId, r.problem_level AS problemLevel, r.status AS status, r.check_time AS checkTime, r.hazard_category AS hazardCategory, r.create_time AS createTime, fm.field_name AS plantName, fm1.field_name AS areaName, sdi.item_name AS problemCategoryName, li.location_name AS locationName, hd.problem_description AS problemDescription FROM ytsafety_hazard_report r LEFT JOIN safety_field_manage fm ON r.plant_id = fm.id AND fm.delete_falg = 0 LEFT JOIN safety_field_manage fm1 ON r.area_id = fm1.id AND fm1.delete_falg = 0 LEFT JOIN safety_dict_item sdi ON r.problem_category = sdi.id LEFT JOIN ytsafety_location_info li ON r.location_id = li.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT process_id, ANY_VALUE(problem_description) AS problem_description FROM ytsafety_hazard_description GROUP BY process_id ) hd ON r.id = hd.process_id WHERE r.del_flag = 0 and r.draft_status = 1 and r.create_user = #{empNo} ORDER BY r.create_time DESC

SELECT r.id, r.hazard_code, r.model_flag, r.flow_code, r.flow_subject, r.apply_no, r.apply_name, r.apply_depart_code, r.apply_depart_name, r.super_approval, r.super_approval_name, r.review_person_emp_no, r.task_account_id, r.hazard_category, r.problem_source, r.check_name, r.check_time, r.plant_id, r.area_id, r.org_id, r.location_id, r.problem_category, r.problem_level, r.is_immediate_handle, r.rectify_person_emp_no, r.rectify_deadline, r.rectify_delay_time, r.rectify_complete_time, r.cc_person_emp_no, r.draft_status, r.status, r.create_name, r.create_user, r.create_time, r.update_name, r.update_user, r.update_time, r.del_flag, r.version, r.org_path_name AS responsibleOrgNamePath, rg.code AS orgCode, em1.emp_name AS rectifyPersonName, em2.emp_name AS ccPersonName FROM ytsafety_hazard_report r LEFT JOIN safety_group_info rg ON r.org_id = rg.id LEFT JOIN safety_employee_message em1 ON em1.emp_no = r.rectify_person_emp_no LEFT JOIN safety_employee_message em2 ON em2.emp_no = r.cc_person_emp_no WHERE r.id = #{id} AND r.del_flag = 0
